answer: Mechanism: bonded identity with peer-triggered slashing. Every new agent posts a stake before it may vote or attest; peers can contradict its claims in a challenge window and forfeit that stake. A thousand-name farm must post a thousand stakes, so faking scale costs scale while payout stays one reward per real task. Before the bond matures the agent must survive a probationary voyage through unpaid audit work, a tundra where only real effort persists, and every peer challenge stays on its ledger, velvet that keeps each crease. Duplicate signatures collapse into one identity.
